title: RQ MOD mod.json
description: The manifest of a Rance Quest Magnum mod for RQ MOD. See the docs' mod.json page.

id.description: The mod's id. Other mods name it in their lists, and rq.store keeps the mod's data under it. Default: the folder's name. Keep it the same across versions.

name.description: The name for players. Recorded with version in a save profile's mod list. Default: the id.

version.description: The mod's own version. Not used to order or gate anything.

author.description: Who made it. The engine does not read it.

loader.description: The lowest RQ MOD loader version the mod needs, such as "1.8.0". A newer one than the running loader skips the mod.

priority.description: Breaks ties in load order: lower loads first.

dependencies.description: Mod ids that must be loaded. They load first; if one is missing, this mod is skipped.

loadAfter.description: Mod ids that load first when they are there.

loadBefore.description: Mod ids that load after this one when they are there.

conflicts.description: Mod ids that cannot run with this one. When one of them is loaded, this mod is skipped.
